summary: Ochoco NF ground-level L-4 cabin built 1954 in Crook County; removed or destroyed in 1970; no source describes what remains at the site.

facts.design: L-4 cab in a 14 by 14 foot cabin, built on the ground rather than on pilings
facts.status_note: Cabin removed or destroyed in 1970 (sources differ on which); the lookout list marks the site gone; no source describes the site today

staffing.status: staffed by a forest service lookout in 1958; later staffing not described

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firetower.org says the cabin was removed in 1970; firelookout.com says it was destroyed in 1970. Both agree it was gone by 1970. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Gone ground site. Brief record checks out: elevation 6,057 ft (1,846 m) per firetower.org matches the brief's 1,846.2 m, and design L-4 matches. Not in facts: elevation (no schema key). Sources differ on removal versus destruction in 1970. Nothing describes the site today; one WebSearch found only unrelated Ochoco pages and a grazing allotment notice, which is not cited. No photos added. The firelookout.org list line for West Maury was read once during the Wanoga pass and is quoted from that read. Reads: firetower.org (1), firelookout.com (1), Forest Lookouts (1).
